status_semantics.what_is_locked: the design language and the generalized rules: premium minimal, warm-white body with a desaturated warm-gold emphasis, condensed heavy upper-case, light stroke and soft shadow instead of a dark plate, restrained fade-and-settle, stable upper body zone
status_semantics.what_is_not_claimed: this profile does NOT reproduce the approved A frames pixel-for-pixel. The approved artifacts disagree about their own pixel sizes (see known_discrepancy), so no pixel-exact claim can be made from them.
status_semantics.consequence: a job adopting this baseline inherits the rules and the design language; it states and verifies its own pixel values, and must not cite this file as proof that its render matches A.

provenance.note: This file is ONE JOB'S PARAMETERS. It is not a rule and must not be copied into module code as a default. The next SKU states its own.

font.why_it_works: a condensed heavy grotesque: narrow enough that long Indonesian selling lines stay one line, heavy enough to hold against busy bathroom footage without a plate

colours.notes: warm white for the body of a line, low-saturation warm gold for the emphasised word. The gold is deliberately desaturated: a saturated yellow would read as discount retail, which the baseline avoids.

type_scale.sizes_provenance: taken from the typography_a.ass style defaults, which is only ONE of the two approved artifacts; the overlay renderer states sizes about 1.12x larger. Which one produced the accepted frames is unresolved, so treat these as the design language rather than as verified approved pixels. REFERENCE_PIXEL_REPRODUCTION = UNRESOLVED.
type_scale.notes: role base sizes are the design language; the per-event size is adapted to text length and is carried by the job's own typography request, not by this file

readability_devices.notes: readability is bought with a light stroke, a soft shadow and whitespace - never with a large dark information plate, which rule AD-09 forbids

motion.notes: a short fade plus a 14 px upward settle. Motion serves reading only (rule AD-11); nothing bounces, rotates or loops

zone_usage.notes: no zone overrides are needed: the shipped zone set already contains A's layout. A's text occupies roughly y 0.096-0.185 of the canvas at x 0.080, which sits inside UPPER_LEFT (x 0.055, y 0.085, w 0.845, h 0.115).

emphasis_reference.note: which word A emphasised, per event, as an example of the pattern rather than a rule

known_discrepancy.what: the ASS spec and the overlay renderer state different pixel sizes for the same events
known_discrepancy.ratio: the renderer is uniformly about 1.12x the ASS
known_discrepancy.why_it_matters: only if a future job wants to reproduce A's sizes exactly. It does not affect the rules, which do not mention pixel sizes.
